llm_response.reason: The site displays numerous scam signals: 1) Copies e-commerce (Lazada) footers, policies, and categories but is mainly a gambling site, revealing brand spoofing; 2) Promises easy winnings and very low minimums, appealing to greed and urgency; 3) No legitimate business or contact information, all details obscured; 4) Domain registration is behind privacy, not matching gambling or shop branding/location; 5) Mixes different product types and services incompatible for a single legitimate business. These are all classic red flags of scam/fake shopping/gambling sites.
